title: Code for: Comparing survival prediction models with sharp bounds on Brier-risk differences before local outcomes are available
description: Code and aggregate results for the simulation study and the three public-data applications (Rotterdam to German Breast Cancer Study Group; Rotterdam earlier to later patients; National Wilms Tumor Study 3 to 4) comparing two fixed survival predictors before target outcomes are available. The code computes sharp bounds for the candidate-minus-reference Brier-risk difference under bounded conditional log-odds shifts, the corresponding separate-risk subtraction intervals, censoring-adjusted estimates, and simultaneous bootstrap confidence envelopes. Patient-level data are not included; the datasets are exported from the R package survival.
